info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Mortgage Loans Apply-v5-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Application API facilitates the submission of mortgage loan applications. This endpoint allows users to batch submit multiple loan applications efficiently, expediting the processing time for financial institutions. Typical consumers include banks, credit unions, and mortgage lenders looking to enhance their application intake processes. By leveraging this API, developers can integrate streamlined mortgage loan application functionality into their services, improving user experience and operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a loan application. Provide the necessary details in the request body to apply for a loan. Ensure all required fields are filled accurately to process the application effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a loan application. Ensure all required fields are provided to process the application successfully.

200.description: The loan application has been processed successfully.

CreateMortgageLoansApplyRequest.title: Loan Application Request

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number for tracking the application.

customer.description: Details about the customer applying for the loan.

resource.description: The resource or funding source for the loan.

priority.description: The priority level of the loan application.

amount.description: The amount of money requested in the loan application.

currency.description: The currency in which the loan amount is specified.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates if notifications are required for the loan application.

requestedAt.description: The date and time when the loan was requested.

channel.description: The channel through which the loan application is submitted.

recordIndex.description: An index indicating the position of the record in a list.
